notes.subject: יחצה
notes.rationale: 'divideth' — either the flood splits at the neck-height (water rising to the neck) or it sifts the nations in two; YLT/JPS keep the dividing, Bambara follows 'reaches to the neck and splits'.

notes.subject: kayiden
notes.rationale: נפת is a sieve for grain; Bambara uses the winnowing-sieve word — same agri-picture, different implement.

notes.subject: מתעה
notes.rationale: 'causing to err' — some read the bridle as leading the peoples astray, others as guiding them back (causative of straying); Bambara keeps the leading-astray sense.

translation: A ka fiɲɛ misɛn baji min bɛ ɲɔgɔn gɛlɛya, ka se a kunfɛ ka a dogo, walasa ka siyaw jɛ ni kayiden ye min bɛ joli gɛlɛn fo, ani sɔnsɔnnen min bɛ taa-ɲɛgɛn bila, jama'w ka nyɛda la.
